about: Saint-Lin–Laurentides is a city in Québec’s Lanaudière region, northwest of Montréal beyond the immediate North Shore suburbs. It mixes a historic village associated with Sir Wilfrid Laurier’s birthplace with newer residential growth along rural highways. Farmland and woodlots still surround much of the municipality. About 24,000 people live in Saint-Lin–Laurentides.
seoSummary: Lanaudière city northwest of Montréal, known for Laurier’s birthplace and surrounding farmland.
